findings: P1: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog.go:62 | root cause: vaultMappingCatalog.Load maps every Vault.Verify error to an empty snapshot, so NewService/activate restore no mappings whenever catalog Verify fails for a reason other than first-missing | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog.go:89, plugins/cloudflare-dns/service.go:56, plugins/cloudflare-dns/controller.go:186, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:619 | impact: after Stop/Activate or process restart a transient/non-not-found Verify leaves the live service without the last successful save, mapped domains miss and can fall back, and the next persist Enroll-miss then Rotate can overwrite the durable catalog with that empty or partial snapshot | minimal fix: fail Load/NewService unless Verify is a dedicated not-found; never treat an existing catalog as empty or Rotate it from an unrestored in-memory snapshot

P2[advisory]: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:158 | root cause: writes enroll/mutate live mappings first and persistMappings afterwards; persist failure is not rolled back, and finishCommittedMapping/same-suffix replay skip persist so the suffix epoch/secret_ref stays unretired | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:619, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:631, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog.go:157, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:564 | impact: a failed catalog save can still appear on same-process refresh, disappear after restart, and a later create of that suffix can conflict or reuse the leftover Vault enroll instead of storing the new Token | minimal fix: include catalog persist in commit/replay and on persist failure roll back the live mutation and retire the suffix epoch
result.summary: Terminal closure 已覆盖累计 c110d73..b2969fd 的 11 个路径、dependency reader 事实、T-mapping-ui Recipe（R3，test=new）与 A1 三项历史 findings。已核对维度：授权 CRUD；未授权/匿名/只读拒绝；删除/轮换/改后缀确认与取消；list/detail/edit/error/audit/JSON 脱敏；缺 Operation-Key 的二次轮换与长后缀；token 表单 method=post；Close/NewService 与 Stop/Activate 成功路径重载；catalog 与 mapping secret_ref 不碰撞；Create/Share/Rename/Rotate/Delete persist 与 retired/epoch；Load/Save 的 Verify-missing 对 Verify-error、Reveal/损坏 JSON、persist 失败与 committed replay；Cancel/live 与 inactive 503；ResolveToken 重启消费方；排除 DNS/区域 Token/ui.schema。A1 三项原根因已关闭。
